title: Approval request/callback (outbound)
description: Source: core/approval/src/main/java/com/agenticai/core/approval/dto/ApprovalRequestResponse.java, read directly (2026-07-19) - a Java record, fields in declaration order. ApprovalStatus enum values inlined from core/approval/ApprovalStatus.java (read directly, same date; note EXECUTION_FAILED is overloaded to also mean 'will retry' when nextRetryAt is non-null, per that enum's own comment - this schema does not attempt to encode that cross-field relationship, just documents it here). This is what GET /api/approvals/** returns (ApprovalRequestResponse.from(ApprovalRequest)), not the JPA entity.

retryCount.description: Autonomy/Guardrails Strategy Stage C. How many retries this action has been through so far.

nextRetryAt.description: Non-null iff status=EXECUTION_FAILED AND a retry is actually scheduled (per ApprovalStatus's own enum comment) - null for every other status, and for EXECUTION_FAILED rows that exhausted retries or were never retryable.

payload.description: Raw JSON text (not re-parsed server-side - the frontend pretty-prints it), genuinely nullable per this field's own javadoc: older rows predating a given action type's payload shape, or an action type that never set one, come back null.
